scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
